title: A: one GREASE id across app_components, safe_aad and dictionary (-11 §5.2)
description: identity.rs leaf_extensions draws three independent random GREASE component ids (app_components ~:405, safe_aad ~:411, dictionary ~:420). mls-extensions-11 §5 (L966-973) and §5.2 (L1072-1075): a dictionary entry must be listed in the leaf's app_components, so a GREASE dictionary entry must be too; ~7/8 of mimid leaves are invalid to an -11 peer. Use one GREASE id. Regression test first.
close_reason: identity.rs leaf_extensions uses one GREASE id for app_components, safe_aad and the dictionary entry (mls-extensions-11 §5, §5.2). Test leaf_dictionary_entries_are_listed_in_app_components (64 identities, mls-rs decode, independent strict parser) failed first (dictionary entry 0x2a2a not in app_components); two existing tests tightened to require equal ids. No fixture changes. Gates pass in worktree; applied to main.
